summary: Ellington Financial Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 8, 2026, announcing board-declared dividends on its common and preferred stock. The company declared a monthly common dividend of $0.13 per share, payable October 30, 2026, to holders of record September 30, 2026. Quarterly preferred dividends were also declared: $0.390625 per Series B share, $0.5390625 per Series C share, and $0.4375 per Series D share. The filing is a routine dividend declaration under Item 8.01, not a special situation; no deal terms are present, and the risk-arb angle is not applicable.
